catalog_scope: The data directory contains the Earth, Titan and Venus catalogs. The regional Titan benchmark uses the longitude-sector catalog.

class_ranking.scope: Within-region average precision for all six classes and all sixty Craters curves from saved initialization probabilities; offline CPU reconstruction without fitting.

crater_analysis.scope: Expected training-label batch availability and saved-prediction joins to known map cells; CPU reproduction without model fitting.

dofa_band_comparison.scope: CPU reconstruction of ten test results for five regions and two DOFA input values.

dofa_partial_training.scope: Fifty saved class-prediction vectors and all class and macro metrics, with paired numeric-input comparisons; independent CPU reconstruction. Source subset supports inspection and preparation with additional execution prerequisites.

loss_execution_source.scope: ResNet18 training source and synthetic CPU checks for two weighted-loss denominators; numerical results supplied separately.

loss_normalization_comparison.scope: Saved predictions and compact histories for fifteen additional loss-normalization fits; standard-library CPU reconstruction reuses the original initialization archive.

map_census.scope: All 23,380 saved map grids and SAR validity masks with five-fold role assignments; CPU reconstruction of 26 aggregate groups under four coverage rules.

regional_classifier_source.scope: Training source and CPU tests for the regional encoder comparisons.

saved_prediction_reconstruction.scope: CPU reconstruction of the adaptation results from saved predictions. The package verifier checks the acceptance record and exported outputs.

software.scope: Titan classifier software, feature extraction and saved-result comparisons.

terrain_plots.scope: Regional AP differences for all six classes, absolute Craters AP, retrieval curves for all six classes, regional SGD variation and map-mixture summaries, and Titan/Earth/Venus sampling displays. Saved predictions and accepted geographic records; no model execution.

tile_array_scope: 60 follow-up SAR inspection packets and 37 reassessment SAR/map excerpts; not asserted to be disjoint.
